features.name: Feature Settings — General tab
features.description: Account-level General settings: User activation toggle and the Guides, tutorials & announcements feature with user-deployment management.

features.name: Feature Settings — Phone tab
features.description: Phone settings: external-app launch for incoming calls (with deployment + URL config), Auto-answer calls, and Conference calls.

features.name: Feature Settings — AI tab
features.description: Master AI features card with per-product retention, plus AVA / Phone AI / Chat AI parent cards whose detail pages (deep-linkable via ?detail=) hold the dependent features and cascade rules.

features.name: Feature Settings — SMS tab
features.description: Read-only SMS Service card: enabled at the account level and locked with an explanatory info tooltip.

features.name: Feature Settings — Fax tab
features.description: Fax master toggle with dependent Email-to-Fax feature; dependent card hides entirely while Fax is off and turning Fax off cascades Email-to-Fax off.
